commands.command:
"<USER>\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path skills -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath mirror/current-export -Destination skills/current-export -Recurse
$inputPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath input.json).Path
$inputBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($inputPath)
$source = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($inputBytes) | ConvertFrom-Json
$total = 0
foreach ($value in $source.values) { $total += $value }
$sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
try { $digest = ([System.BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($inputBytes))).Replace('"'-', '').ToLowerInvariant() } finally { "'$sha.Dispose() }
$result = [ordered]@{ generation = $source.generation; total = $total; input_sha256 = $digest }
$json = $result | ConvertTo-Json
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) output.json), $json + [Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))'
